Effect.chelating: +{bonus} (TL/2) to HT rolls against metal poisoning (antimony, arsenic, lead); also removes radioactive matter (Campaigns p. 436).
Effect.psychiatric: Taken daily, a Mitigator (Characters p. 112) on the disadvantages it treats. Strong ones have side effects of their own.
Effect.truthSerum: After 30 seconds, 1d FP, and HT-1 to avoid -2 to Will and self-control rolls for (20 - HT)/2 minutes.
Effect.dmso: One dose lets one dose of a blood or digestive agent work as a contact agent.
Effect.curare: Follow-up, a minute's delay: 2d toxic every 30 minutes for four cycles, whatever the roll. HT-6: a failure paralyses, a critical failure chokes too. An antitoxin takes 30 minutes to work.
Effect.ricin: Blood, digestive or respiratory, eight hours' delay: 3d toxic, nausea and vomiting every eight hours for ten cycles, whatever the roll. HT-2: a failure brings coughing; failing the first roll and a later one, choking.
Effect.strychnine: Digestive, 15 minutes' delay: seizures every five minutes for 2d hours, and a HT roll each time against choking.
Effect.botulin: Digestive, 12 hours' delay: 4d toxic, nausea and retching; then HT-1 every 12 hours against paralysis, a point worse each time. An antitoxin given before paralysis stops it.
Effect.thallium: Digestive, three hours' delay: 1d toxic every 24 hours for ten cycles, no roll, and the radiation's gastrointestinal syndrome.

Vehicles.Title: Vehicle components
Vehicles.GunPortBulk: Too bulky for a gun port (Bulk worse than {bulk})
Vehicles.GunPortNote: From a gun port: a {arc}-degree arc; a sealed vehicle is unsealed while it is in use
Vehicles.LinkedNote: Linked weapons fired as one at RoF {rof}
Vehicles.HearCrew: Inside a tank, motor running, no headsets

Fitting.tank: Crew ride as in a tank

Line.gunPorts: Gun ports ({count}): {skill} to skill, a {arc}-degree arc, no weapon bulkier than {bulk}; {outside} to hit the shooter from outside.
Line.turret: Turret: {readies} Ready maneuvers per 60 degrees; its cannon can't usually fire while it turns.
Line.turretSeconds: Mount: {seconds} second per 60 degrees, and it fires as it turns.
Line.searchlight: Searchlight ({miles} mile): lights a circle of {radius} yards' radius at that range; the beam is seen {spotted} miles off.
Line.smoke: Smoke dischargers: a screen {wide} x {high} x {deep} yards, {yards} yards off, in {forms} seconds.
Line.extinguisher: Fire extinguisher: puts a fire out on {target} or less.
Line.suppression: Fire-suppression system: puts a fire out on {target} or less, again after {seconds} seconds.
Line.runFlat: Run-flat tyres: flat, {handling} Handling and Move less 20% for {miles} miles.
Line.ctis: CTIS: ignores up to {flats} flat tyres.
Line.airbags: Airbags: DR {dr} in a crash above Move {move}.
Line.brakes: Improved brakes: +{bonus} to keep control while braking hard.
Line.laminated: Laminated armour: DR x2 against HEAT and HEDP; no HESH spall.
Line.spaced: Spaced armour ({where}): DR x1.5 against HEAT and HEDP; no HESH spall.
Line.skirt: Armour skirts: DR {dr} on the {part} sides, as spaced armour.
Line.riveted: Riveted armour: {damage}+ stopped may send rivets flying inside.
Line.tank: Tank crew: -4 to hear each other with the motor running, -10 to hear outside; -2 Vision buttoned up.
Line.tankIntercom: Tank crew with headsets: -10 to hear outside with the motor running; -2 Vision buttoned up.

Spall.Title: Flying rivets
Spall.Hit: Occupant Hit Table: {roll} against {target}: a crewman takes {damage} cutting.
Spall.Missed: Occupant Hit Table: {roll} against {target}: nobody hit.

Tool.Title: Vehicle components
Tool.free: Get out from behind an airbag
Tool.NoTurret: It has no turret with a figure for turning.
Tool.TurretSeconds: Turning {degrees} degrees takes {seconds} seconds, firing as it turns.
Tool.TurretFire: Its cannon can't usually fire while it turns; machine guns often can.
Tool.Smokescreen: A smokescreen {wide} yards wide, {high} high and {deep} deep, {yards} yards off the face it was fired from: it forms in {forms} seconds and disperses after {minutes} minutes.
Tool.NoSearchlight: It has no searchlight on record.
Tool.Lit: At {miles} miles the beam lights a circle of {radius} yards' radius; it can be seen {spotted} miles off.
Tool.SearchlightHt: HT against the searchlight at night

Flats.ctis: {flats} flat: the CTIS keeps them up; no effect.
Flats.runFlat: {flats} flat: on its run-flat tyres, {handling} Handling and Move less 20%, for {miles} miles.
Flats.flat: {flats} flat, with no run-flat tyres: see the wheel hit location (Campaigns p. 555).

Tool.AirbagsStay: The airbags fire only above Move {move}.
Tool.AirbagsFired: The airbags fire for {count} aboard: DR {dr} against the crash; each does nothing else until he gets free (DX{escape} a turn).
Tool.FreeLabel: Getting out from behind an airbag
Tool.Rode: {hours} hours riding inside: {fp} FP each for {count}.
Tool.RodeHeadOut: {hours} hours riding with heads outside: no FP.
Tool.ButtonedUp: Buttoned up: {vision} to Vision, nothing seen within {yards} yards; a loader sees nothing, a gunner 60 degrees where the turret faces, a driver 90 degrees ahead, the commander all round.

Backblast.IndoorsReflects: Indoors, the backblast reflects off the walls at the firer.
Backblast.IndoorsSafe: A countermass weapon is safe to fire indoors.
Backblast.IndoorsDeafening: The report stuns a firer who fails a HT{penalty} roll; temporary Hard of Hearing is almost certain.
